voyage.name: The Million-Year Stone Park and Crocodile Farm
voyage.alt: อุทยานหินล้านปีและฟาร์มจระเข้พัทยา
voyage.content: Features an exotic zoo and crocodiles, fire-swallowing and magic shows, as well as the garden and stone park. Its grounds are landscaped with flowering and rock gardens. Hundreds of crocodiles as well as some rare animals, including albino bears and horses, are kept. There are crocodile shows, magic performances and animal shows 7 times a day from 09:00-17:00.

voyage.name: Pattaya Elephant Village
voyage.alt: หมู่บ้านช้างพัทยา
voyage.content: This elephant camp focuses on the daily lives of elephants and their keepers and also offers stage shows demonstrating how to catch wild elephants, elephants-at-work in the jungle, elephants playing football, and a grand war elephants parade. The shows are held daily at 14:30 and last one hour.

voyage.name: Ban Sukhawadee
voyage.alt: บ้านสุขาวดี
voyage.content: This is the residence of Dr. Panya Chotithewan. Visitors can enter the house to pay respect to the Bodhisattva Kwan Yin, to see the spacious conference room and the roof.

voyage.name: Buddha Hill
voyage.alt: เขาพระตำหนัก หรือ เขาพระบาท Khao Phra Tam Nak
voyage.content: Buddha Hill is one of the highest points in Pattaya. At the summit is the biggest Buddha statue in Pattaya, and nearby is a beautiful Chinese-style sacred area dedicated to Confucius and Lao-zi. The next hill, just across Phra Tam Nak Rd, has the best Pattaya Bay coastline viewpoint and is also worth a visit, especially for sunsets. The locals come here to pay homage to Wat Khao Phra Bat atop the hill and the monumen

voyage.name: Chaloemphrakiat Park
voyage.alt: สวนเฉลิมพระเกียรติ
voyage.content: A park at the foot of Khao Pattaya. With an area of 6 acres, the park was dedicated to commemorate His Majesty the King's sixtieth birthday on 5 Dec 1988. The gardens of the park boast a wide variety of flowering plants and offer a scenic view of Pattaya. There are also multi-purpose grounds and winding trails for walking or jogging and standard exercise facilities. It is not at all obvious how to access the gardens

voyage.name: Sanctuary of Truth
voyage.alt: ปราสาทสัจธรรม
voyage.content: This huge ancient-style wooden temple is by the sea at Laem Ratchawet, north Pattaya. The entrance is at Soi 12, Na Kluea Rd. The Sanctuary of Truth was first begun in 1981 by Mr. Lek Wiriyaphan, the founder of the Ancient City in Samut Prakan Province. With exquisite unique architectural features, the building was conceived out of the vision that human civilisation has been achieved and nurtured by religious and phi

voyage.name: Mini Siam
voyage.alt: เมืองจำลองพัทยา
voyage.content: Mini Siam features miniature replicas of iconic structures from Thailand and all over the world. It is one of the most famous model villages in the world. It celebrates the heritages of Thailand with miniature replicas of the most famous monuments and historical sites including the Temple of the Emerald Buddha, Democracy Monument, Bridge over the River Kwai, Prasat Hin Phimai, etc. Miniature replicas of the Tower Bri

voyage.name: Siriphon Orchid Farm
voyage.alt: สวนกล้วยไม้ศิริพร
voyage.content: Inside the farm are various kinds of orchids to be admired and purchased such as Pompadua, Vanda, Golden Shower, and Cattleya.

voyage.name: Wong Phra Chan Beach
voyage.alt: หาดวงพระจันทร์
voyage.content: This small tranquil 1 kilometre beach is on the north side of Pattaya Bay. The serene atmosphere here is attractive to those longing for a complete rest and privacy.

voyage.name: Alcazar Cabaret
voyage.alt: อัลคาซ่าร์ คาบาร์เร่ต์
voyage.content: Directly after the show the performers come outside for a few minutes photo session.

voyage.name: Tiffany's Show
voyage.alt: ทิฟฟานี่ โชว์
voyage.content: Tiffany's is a family-friendly ladyboy cabaret show. The 19:30 show is generally deemed to be the best of the night. After the show there the ladyboys would gather outside available for photos sessions with interested audience. However, be aware that taking photos with the ladyboy means you are obligated to give the ladyboy tips depending on the rank of the ladyboy (front row ladyboys are more costly to take photos w

voyage.name: Major Cineplex
voyage.content: Shows similar movies to the SFX cinema in Central Festival but is about 20 baht cheaper. Regular ticket for 120 baht (80 baht on Wednesdays).

voyage.name: SFX Cinema
voyage.content: Multiplex with 10 theatres on the 6th floor of the Central Festival shopping complex. One theatre has first class seats including popcorn and a soft drink.

voyage.name: SF Cinema City
voyage.content: This cinema has six theatres, slightly more at weekends; this has increasingly been showing Thai-soundtrack-only films (including dubbed versions of foreign films and no-English-subtitle releases of Thai films).

voyage.name: Real Divers Pattaya PADI 5 Star IDC Center
Art in Paradise
voyage.content: This is an “illusion” art museum that features ten galleries – the Camouflage Room, Under the Ocean Room, Wildlife Room, Classical Art Room, Civilization Room, Surrealism Room, Dinosaur Room, Waterfall Room, Scenery Room, and Exhibition of Art Room. Great place for any one who loves to snap selfies!

voyage.name: Pattaya Paintball and Airsoft Park
voyage.content: Decent field; helpful English speaking manager.

voyage.name: Pattaya Kart Speedway
voyage.alt: พัทยาคาร์ท สปีดเวย์
voyage.content: A kart racing circuit where there are separate lanes for professionals and amateurs, and there is a separate "off-road" track.

voyage.name: Ripley's Believe It Or Not
voyage.price: Foreigners 380 baht/adult and 280 baht/child, Thais 280 baht/adult, 230 baht/child
voyage.content: At the same location there's also a "Haunted Experience" show, a 4D movie theatre and "Infinity Maze" game. Various combination tickets available to enter all four.

voyage.name: Tiffany's Shooting Range
voyage.address: GF, Tiffany's Show Building, 464 Moo 9, Second Rd
voyage.content: The only indoor shooting range in Pattaya with 19 lanes. Minimum age 18.

voyage.name: Video games
voyage.content: Video games are a popular pastime in Thailand, hence PlayStation and computer game shops are everywhere in Pattaya. Making a pretty cheap entertainment, but expect things to get very crowded and loud in the hours after school lets out. There's a big shop on Soi Chaiyaphum (right off Soi Buakhao across from Soi Diana Inn) that's open 24/7 and has more comfortable chairs.

voyage.name: New Year's Day
voyage.content: 1 Jan has been adopted as New Year's Day. On the first of January, people offer food to monks at the temple or at a particular site designated by government offices of private organizations.

voyage.name: Songkran
voyage.content: Mid-April. Songkran is the Thai New Year, celebrated primarily by everyone throwing prodigious quantities of water at anything that moves. Pattaya officially celebrates Songkran on later dates (April 18–19) than most of the rest of the country (April 13–15) - but in reality the fun just starts early and keeps on going that much longer. During this period many hotels and guest houses have high occupancy levels, and pu

voyage.name: Pattaya Festival
voyage.content: Mid-April. The Pattaya Festival has floral floats, a Miss Pattaya Beauty contest, a traditional aquatic sports competitions, castles, a fireworks display, fire crackers, arts and cultural performances, exhibitions and souvenirs for sale. Don't expect an "authentic" festival, this is basically a festival to promote Pattaya as a popular seaside destination for tourists.

voyage.name: The Golf Club
voyage.content: A popular sports bar & restaurant that runs regular golf competitions on M, Tu, Th, and F. They have contracts with the local courses and offer highly discounted green fees either through the Pattaya Sports Club or they can book your private tour of up to 120 golfers. They are the only bar golf society with a TAT Licence. Transportation, club rentals, free Wi-Fi and golf lockers are available. Have 4 rooms available

voyage.name: The Mini Golf Pub
voyage.content: 18 holes, refreshments available; their cat sometimes acts as a self-propelled obstacle.

voyage.name: Pattaya City Golf
voyage.content: 18 holes, plus chipping, driving and putting areas for the more serious golfer; refreshments served at the waterfront bar; caddy service available.

voyage.name: Ko Khrok
voyage.alt: or Krok
voyage.content: 2 km east of Ko Laan, is an isolated rocky islet with a single 100 metre stretch of sandy beach to the east, where visitors can see coral reefs.

voyage.name: Ko Phai
voyage.alt: หมู่เกาะไผ่ or Bamboo Island
voyage.content: Ko Phai, and other islands in the Ko Phai group, Ko Klung Badan (or Krung Badan), Ko Luam (or Leom), Ko Man Wichai and Ko Rin (or Lin) - are preferred destinations for scuba divers, and are also popular for general relaxation, fishing, swimming and snorkeling day trips. This area is controlled by the Royal Thai Navy, and overnight stays are not permitted. For a return speedboat charter from one of the mainland beache

voyage.name: Spa View
voyage.content: One of the largest massage and spa complexes in Pattaya, offering aromatherapy oil massage, herbal steam sauna, skin whitening treatment, body treatment with aloe vera herbal, mineral water treatment, body treatment with milk and honey, milk bath treatment, physical massage, foot massage, and others. Facial treatments include nail care and treatment, hand and foot therapy by soaking with herbal water, foot massage, f

voyage.name: Pattaya Muay Thai Academy
voyage.alt: พัทยา มวยไทย สถานศึกษา เมืองพัทยา ประเทศไทย
voyage.content: A popular muay Thai camp that is open to everyone for fitness, self-defence and fighter training. The gym is fully matted, including a large open training area, a boxing ring, several punch and kick bags as well as fitness equipment. Accommodation is available in camp, the instructors are multilingual, free Wi-Fi for customers, and the option of fighting at muay Thai stadiums.

voyage.name: Open Eyes Show
voyage.alt: เปิดหู เปิดตาโชว์
voyage.content: "The Great Experience Behind The Magical", a lot of technological magic and illusion shows. It is a magic performance in various styles such as Aladdin, the Mermaid, Invisible Woman, the Wonderland, etc.

voyage.name: Tuxedo Illusion Hall
voyage.alt: ปราสาทเวทมนต์ ทักซิโด
voyage.content: It is a magic theatre in the form of a split-level restaurant. There are series of shows such as making an umbrella out of cards.

voyage.name: Pattaya Lake Land Cable Ski
voyage.content: Lake Land Cable Ski is a manmade, freshwater lake beside Sukhumvit Road, not far from Jomtien Beach. Water skiing and wakeboarding.

voyage.name: Canterbury Tales Cafe, Guesthouse & Bookshop
voyage.content: Probably Pattaya's largest second hand bookshop. It's run by an Englishman called Dave. Also has a cafe restaurant and rooms. The cafe at the front is a popular meeting place with expats, mostly from UK, US and Australia.

voyage.name: SE-ED
voyage.content: This store has several branches, at Big C, South Pattaya Rd; Carrefour, Central Pattaya Rd; Tesco-Lotus, North Pattaya Rd; Tesco-Lotus, Sukhumvit Rd.

voyage.name: Central Festival
voyage.content: One of the largest malls in Asia. It is the best shopping mall in the region and now attracts customers from all over, adding to the traffic chaos of Beach Rd. Fashion, electronics, health & beauty, kids activities and food are all here. With the obligatory cinema complex and bowling alley on the top floor, this mega-mall is styled on the big Bangkok destination shopping areas like Siam Paragon. The Food Loft has the

voyage.name: Mike Shopping Mall
voyage.content: The ground floor has many small stalls selling clothing, tourist souvenirs and many other inexpensive items; above that there's a department store; on the 5th floor there's a food court; and up on the roof (10th floor) there's a public swimming pool.

voyage.name: Tukcom
voyage.content: A predominantly IT mall. In the basement is a Tops supermarket, a food court, and various other (mostly clothes) shops as well as a spare parts department that sells a variety of electronics (e.g., transistors) and other parts (e.g., washing machine lint filters), and the ground floor hosts an assortment of regular shops. However the upper floors are almost exclusively mobile phones (1st floor), computer software (4t

voyage.name: Tesco Lotus Pattaya Nuea
voyage.content: sells most things you need.

voyage.name: Made In Thailand Night Bazaar
voyage.content: Despite the name, it is also open in mornings.

voyage.name: The Market Pattaya
voyage.content: This market is a little lonely, but some evenings it has students giving music or dance performances on a small stage.

voyage.name: Soi Buakhao Market
voyage.content: Daytime on Tuesdays and Fridays; plus an evening market further along the same road.

voyage.name: Gems Gallery
voyage.content: One of several "World's Biggest" jewelry stores, this one also has a theme park.

voyage.name: Several outdoor food stalls
voyage.content: along Soi 15 (just off Walking Street). Foreigner friendly and cheap prices (e.g., fried rice, 50 baht; chicken, rice and soup, 30 baht).

voyage.name: Fra Pattaya
voyage.content: Unassuming setting yet absolutely excellent food. Good place for Thai food. Completely local. It's like market area ambience. A real Sino Thai restaurant where you can enjoy a lacquered duck.

voyage.name: King Kebab
voyage.content: Perfect for eating kebabs. It's good for a quick bite to eat on the go. Kebab really good served in this little place. The owner is very courteous, the prompt service. Good before clubbing and afterwards.

voyage.name: Baywatch Restaurant
voyage.content: Don't let its unassuming appearance fool you. This hole-in-the-wall has great food. The American breakfast is a great deal. Bacon, eggs, taters, toast, coffee, and fresh squeezed juice. Their cheeseburgers are beyond anything. On the other side, asking for anything special or substitutions like "can I have rice instead of potatoes?" will met with a curt "no!". Still delicious.

voyage.name: Das-Berliner Bistro
voyage.content: Hidden German gem in the center of Pattaya. Great Food and Service. Delicious food and Helmut is a very nice owner. Feel the German ‘roots’.

voyage.name: Food Court of the Central Festival shopping mall
voyage.content: There are low-priced restaurants.

voyage.name: Sailor Bar and Restaurant
voyage.content: Good restaurant and bar, notable for its 65 baht breakfasts. Nice environment. There is Thai food and European food here, lots to choose from. Free Wi-Fi.

voyage.name: Mae sri ruen
voyage.content: This is a restaurant where you can enjoy a meal while watching the sunset. You can eat indoors and outdoors. The place is very nice and the staff very kind.

voyage.name: Aroy Dee Pattaya
voyage.content: The menu is huge and offers a variety of food choices including Thai, American, Italian and European cuisines. Excellent service from very helpful friendly staff.

voyage.name: YIAM Restaurant
voyage.content: Enjoy your meal with Thai and international cuisine. Friendly staff. Short waiting time.

voyage.name: Kiss Food & Drinks 2 Second Road
voyage.content: It serves cheap and cheerful Thai and Western favourites 24/7 at two semi-open-air locations - one on Second Rd opposite Mike Shopping Mall, the other in Naklua Road just past Boncafe - also in Jomtien and Soi Pornprapanimit (Soi Siam Country Club)

voyage.name: Food court in the basement of the Tukcom shopping mall
voyage.content: It has stalls with a wide range of cheap Thai dishes. See the Buy | Malls section

voyage.name: Big C Extra Food Court
voyage.content: Temporarily closed as of May 2022. It has good food including cheap Isaan treats, such as som tam (papaya salad) and khao neow (sticky rice). The Big C Extra stand, usually near the parking garage entrance, has inexpensive sandwiches.

voyage.name: Tesco Lotus North Pattaya Food Court
voyage.content: A good low-price place to eat.

voyage.name: Nachrichtentreff
voyage.content: Serves pretty good Austrian food.

voyage.name: Nangnual Restaurant
voyage.alt: ร้านอาหารนางนวล
voyage.content: In business since 1965, this is a super restaurant on the water in an unlikely Walking Street location. Seafood is a speciality, but the menu has sections devoted to Western food, Thai food, Italian food, Chinese food, and Japanese food. Extensive wine cellar. Attentive, friendly staff and reasonable prices.

voyage.name: Slice Pizza
voyage.content: An American-style pizzeria.

voyage.name: Trattoria Pizzeria Toscana-Moom Talay Thai Restaurant
voyage.price: Most Thai dishes about 180 baht; pizzas about 300 baht; half-litre of German beer, 200 baht (June 2017)
voyage.content: An unusual combination: an Italian restaurant coupled with a Thai restaurant. The place is huge, with the two restaurants occupying different sections, but sharing menus. Large outside seating area. The restaurant bakes its own bread, makes its own pasta, and sells meat that it raises on its own farm. The ambience is great, with historical photos of Tuscany and hand-painted Italian crockery on the walls. The Italian

voyage.name: The Queen Victoria Inn
voyage.address: Red light district, Pattaya Soi 6, Bang Lamung District
voyage.content: British pub. One of several spots for fish and chips or roast beef and Yorkshire pudding.

voyage.name: Benihana
voyage.content: Japanese steakhouse restaurant chain.

voyage.name: Breezeo
voyage.address: Royal Cliff Beach Hotel & Royal Cliff Beach Terrace
voyage.content: The restaurant serves excellent seafood and Thai dishes.

voyage.name: Hard Rock Cafe
voyage.content: American chain restaurant. The reason to go here is that some beautiful Thai ladies seem to think it's cool.

voyage.name: Five Star J. Restaurant
voyage.alt: "jay"="vegetarian"
voyage.content: A small middle-range indoor place that's 100% lacto-vegetarian and has a vegetarian owner/manager who speaks good English; also caters for vegans.

voyage.name: Govindam 100% Pure Vegetarian & Jain Food
voyage.content: Indian vegetarian restaurant.

voyage.name: Walking Street
voyage.content: Should have been named "Walking, Shopping, Eating, Drinking, Dancing and Ogling Street" as there's plenty of almost everything here—including around 100 beer bars and at least 30 go-go bars, plus many more in the side-sois that lead east towards Pratamnak Road. Worth a look in the daytime, but best visited in the evening, and has loads of restaurants if you're bridging the gap between the two. Gets really packed in p

voyage.name: Pattayaland
voyage.content: Soi Pattayaland 2 (Soi 13/4) features on many Pattaya postcards—when lit up at night, the go-go bar signs are a memorable and photogenic sight, although there are only eight go-go bars here (two of which feature guys, not girls), plus a half-dozen bars and the Penthouse Hotel. Worth a look in the evening (it's almost a ghost town the rest of the time), but get there before 01:00 as that's when the lights go out.

voyage.name: Boyz Town
voyage.content: Features only male dancers and bars that cater for the gay crowd; Soi Pattayaland 1 (Soi 13/3) has even more all-male go-gos (eight), but does have a couple of girl-go-go bars as well. Pattayaland 1 is relatively dead in the daytime, but Pattayaland 3 has a handful of places to eat and drink that keep it ticking over in the afternoon. There is also a small lesbian scene in Pattaya, with local butch girls called "tom"

voyage.name: Soi L.K. Metro
voyage.content: Connecting Soi Diana with Soi Buakhao, Soi L.K., as it is called (not to be confused with Soi Leng Kee) is for the largest part a pedestrianised street. Cars are parked willy nilly, but that actually serves as a traffic calming system so it is safe to walk down. There are lots of outdoor bars and cafes spilling out onto the street, giving it a "bit" of a European feel.

voyage.name: Soi 7 and Soi 8
voyage.content: There's always something going on here—in the evening and early hours, there are about 120 well-staffed beer bars to choose from, plus a handful of go-go bars; in the morning there are several places that serve breakfast; in the afternoon it's a popular place for those who like to get started early; and at Songkran (Thai New Year) it's unmitigated mayhem. There are several large hotels (light sleepers beware), and So

voyage.name: Soi Yodsak
voyage.alt: Soi 6
voyage.content: Imagine a kerb-crawlers paradise—and then pedestrianise it. Arguably Pattaya's most colourful street (as well as the most notorious one), Soi 6 has about 50 bars (mostly "short time" bars, with names such as "Butterfly", "Love Club", "Route 69" and "The Eager Beaver") which all get going at 13:00 and close pretty much on the dot at 01:00. It's not really a pedestrian-only street (but it is one-way), however walking —

voyage.name: Second Road, Soi 2 & Soi 3 Junctions
voyage.content: A collection of about 35 very popular beer bars, which start to fill up from about 16:00, and several of which remain open long after the lights go out around 01:00-02:00. "Atlantic Bar", at the far end of the five-bar strip to the south of Soi 2, always draws a substantial crowd. The only go-go ("Classroom 2", 19:30-02:00) is a lively one, and while there's not much in the way of food in amid the bars themselves, th

voyage.name: Soi Boomerang
voyage.content: Small street with several bars, as well as several go-go bars. Golden Time Agogo, Pink Baby Agogo, Screamers Agogo, Heaven Above Agogo, Baku Lounge, Club Baku, Naughty Club, 555 Bar.

voyage.name: Casino Club
voyage.content: A beer bar.

voyage.name: Tim Bar Beer
voyage.content: An otherwise relatively run-of-the-mill go-go that plays nothing but DVDs, with a very strong bias towards live performances of rock 'n roll classics. Requests welcome. If in doubt, ask for Meatloaf's "Paradise By The Dashboard Light". Stage and screen come to life at 18:00 and keep going until at least 02:00 (closing hours not so strictly enforced here as it's not among a bunch of other bars), but get there early as

voyage.name: Hopf Brew House
voyage.content: Very good own craft beer. Food is good but the place gets packed and service slow with seats hard to find. Live music at least some evenings.

voyage.name: Horizon
voyage.alt: Hilton Hotel
voyage.content: 34th floor rooftop bar. Very high-end, for taking someone special. Great views, particularly at sunset and after dark. Happy hour, 2 for 1 drinks, 17:00 to 19:00, perfect timing for sunset viewing.

voyage.name: Lovely Corner Bar
voyage.hours: 08:00-open as long as there are customers
voyage.content: Clean, airy, well-run beer bar in a great location to view the passing scene before plunging into Soi 7. Very accommodating and gracious, relaxed (not pushy) bar girls. Best feature is strong, free Wi-Fi.

voyage.name: Club Insomnia
voyage.content: House music, cheap drinks, late license, European DJ's.

voyage.name: Lucifer
voyage.content: Popular with young Thai people, although this is not a typical Thai discothèque. Only R 'n B, sometimes with special guest DJs. A good place to go at about 02:00-03:00. Extremely crowded after midnight. Free entry, expensive drinks.

voyage.name: Marine Disco
voyage.content: Large dance floor and plays house music (it's the house music counterpart of Lucifer). Free entry, but drinks are expensive.

voyage.name: MIXX
voyage.content: R 'n B and house rooms (two rooms in one disco). Drinks are expensive.

voyage.name: Tony's Disco
voyage.content: Has an attractive and stylish interior, great live music and service. Free entry, but incredibly expensive drinks - and fine if you're caught bringing your own in!.

voyage.name: The Beach Club
voyage.content: Open air venue, it hosts afternoon parties with the best view of sunsets in town each Friday and each second Saturday - grand fiestas, each of them has a different theme: Brazilian, disco, house, etc.

voyage.name: Benjamit Coffee
voyage.content: Great own brewed coffee, popular with expats

voyage.name: Bake n Brew
voyage.content: Good coffee, cakes and breads. Partially air-conditioned

voyage.name: Cali-Cafe Pattaya Quality Rooms
voyage.address: 15/225-226 Moo 5, Soi Khoa Noi (Wat Boonsampan Rd)
voyage.content: Affordable suite-quality rooms. All suite rooms have 42" LCD TV, safes, refrigerators, kitchens, Wi-Fi, wired (30 Mb fibre) Internet, and laundry. Long- or short-stay. A few minutes motorbike ride from Walking St and Beach Rd. Thai/American-run hotel.

voyage.name: Cheap Charlies
voyage.content: Fan rooms with en suite bath, with or without balcony.

voyage.name: Hotel Dania
voyage.address: (South end of Soi Buakhao near the Soi Buakhao marketplace)316/150 Moo 10 Soi Buakhao
voyage.content: A smallish Danish owned hotel near Soi Buakhao marketplace. Full service restaurant with a pool table and a swimming pool downstairs. Rooms are tidy and clean. Besides the standard rooms there are poolside rooms, suites and the penthouse apartment available. Even there are bar complexes near, there is no noise problems in this hotel.

voyage.name: Ice Inn Hotel
voyage.content: All rooms have air-con, cable TV, fridge/minibar, hot shower, and telephone. Very nice, clean rooms, and helpful staff. For breakfast, you can find 150 baht buffets at Apex Inn or Lek Inn nearby.

voyage.name: Jasmine Hotel Pattaya
voyage.content: Tranquil, refurbished with more than 62 tiled rooms, air conditioning and fans. Room facilities include hot water, cooking facilities, fridge with beverages, and satellite TV (55 channels) and Wi-Fi. Substantial discount for long-term guests.

voyage.name: Honey Inn Pattaya
voyage.address: หมู่ที่ 10 529/41 Pattayasaisong Rd
voyage.content: Multistory contemporary hotel with rooftop pool.

voyage.name: Malee House
voyage.address: 312/51//52 Moo 9 Soi Leng Kee 1 Pattaya Sai 3 Rd
voyage.content: Air-con double room.

voyage.name: Mangoes Guest House
voyage.content: Quiet laid back gardens with a choice of bungalow or room accommodation. All rooms have TV, air conditioning, fan, hot shower and tea making facilities. Long- or short-term.

voyage.name: Marin Place
voyage.content: Small hotel at the south end of Soi Buakhao, close to the Tu/F market. Rooms have air-con, minibar, TV and Wi-Fi. There is a small swimming pool. Some rooms have older, noisy air-conditioning units, but others have new LG units. Ask to see first.

voyage.name: Opey De Place
voyage.content: Many decent rooms, Wi-Fi, elevator and ground floor swimming pool. Small lockers provided next to reception, but no strong boxes in rooms.

voyage.name: Queen Victoria Inn
voyage.content: Although the rooms themselves are clean and the staff is reasonably friendly, its location, right in the heart of Soi 6, is downright noisy and the shouting in the street does not subside till early morning. Free Wi-Fi.

voyage.name: Tiya's Place
voyage.content: Large air-con fully furnished studios with side sea view. Suitable for independent travellers wanting large budget-priced accommodation in a quiet area.

voyage.name: The Spot Bar and Gallery
voyage.content: This place used to be an Asia Backpackers - seems to have spruced up a bit, as it now features kitchenettes, A/C, TV, and balconies in each room, plus a bar and terrace downstairs.

voyage.name: Areca Lodge
voyage.content: Large ground-level pool. The Areca Lodge will reliably book non-smoking rooms.

voyage.name: Dynasty Inn
voyage.content: Two locations in Pattaya. This one and Dynasty Resort (Buddha Hill, Tel. +66 38 250721). Free minibus transfers between the Pattaya locations and Dynasty Inn Bangkok (Sukhumvit, Soi Nana) for guests. Dynasty Inn is in the central shopping area, close to the main night life areas; Dynasty Resort is further south, a short songthaew ride from the main tourist areas. The Dynasty properties will reliably book non-smoking

voyage.name: Flipper House Hotel
voyage.content: In the heart of the best-known cluster of beer bars in Pattaya.

voyage.name: Flipper Lodge Hotel
voyage.content: In the heart of the best known cluster of beer bars in Pattaya, a stones throw from its sister hotel. Room rate includes a super buffet breakfast. Great swimming pool. Wi-Fi costs 150 baht for 24 hr.

voyage.name: Green Park Resort
voyage.content: A friendly, clean, safe, good value. All rooms have air-con, cable TV, fridge/mini-bar, hot shower, security box, telephone, swimming pool. The hotel has 80 rooms and suites, some rooms have private balconies, set in lush gardens.

voyage.name: Horseshoe Point
voyage.address: 100 Moo 9, Tambon Pong, Amphur Banglamung Chonburi
voyage.content: Rooms come in varied sizes but share the same features: air-conditioning, cable TV, mini-bar, refrigerator, hair dryer, and safe.

voyage.name: J&P Court
voyage.content: Has a swimming pool. Standard and deluxe rooms available.

voyage.name: New Nikom Court
voyage.content: Big, clean rooms

voyage.name: Pailin House
voyage.content: Relatively clean and old rooms

voyage.name: Penthouse Hotel
voyage.content: Marketed as an "adult fantasy" hotel featuring "theme rooms". It's in the centre of the main go-go district and directly attached to a go-go bar. It's an older property that's somewhat the worse for wear.

voyage.name: RCG Suites Pattaya
voyage.address: 377 Kao Pra Tum Nak Road, Bang-Lamung, South Pattaya
voyage.content: At Pratamnak Hill, all rooms are provided separate kitchenettes or kitchens, seating area, flat screen TV with satellite channels. Free Wi-Fi is offered to all rooms and free private parking is available.

voyage.name: The Residence Garden
voyage.content: This is a popular out-of-the-way location, a short walk from the intersection of South Pattaya Rd and Pattaya Second Rd, and is a good choice for those looking for somewhere quieter. It has relatively new facilities, with 1 and 2 bedroom suites; discounted lower rates are sometimes available through other sources.

voyage.name: Sandy Spring Hotel
voyage.content: In the central shopping area, close to the main night life areas. Also has a sister hotel Summer Spring on Soi 1.

voyage.name: Sawasdee Sabai
voyage.alt: Sawasdee Court
voyage.content: Sawasdee Sabai (Sawasdee Court) is a colonial Thai-style hotel. 24 hour CCTV security camera and a security guard on duty. Internet cafe, Thai and international cuisine, and room service.

voyage.name: Sunbeam Hotel
voyage.content: One of the cosiest centrally-located hotels close to the beach and shopping arcades.

voyage.name: Sunshine
voyage.content: In the centre of Soi 8. All rooms have air-con, shower or bath tub with hot/cool water, cable TV, fridge with mini-bar.

voyage.name: VTSix Condos at View Talay 6
voyage.alt: VTSIX
voyage.content: Hotel in the View Talay 6 condominium complex with studios and suites up to three bedrooms, many with sea views.

voyage.name: Amari Nova Suites Pattaya
voyage.content: Roof-top pool and rooms with fully-equipped kitchens. Free Wi-Fi.

voyage.name: Amari Pattaya
voyage.content: The deluxe Ocean Tower at the north end of Pattaya Bay, 5 minutes from entertainment areas. One lap pool and one free form, large rooms with LCD TVs and open bathroom concept.

voyage.name: AVANI Pattaya Resort
voyage.content: Centrally located accommodation that offers views of Pattaya Bay and is set amid landscaped gardens. It features standard guest amenities including a swimming pool, dining venues, spa services, and fitness facilities.

voyage.name: Hilton Pattaya
voyage.content: A 5-star high-rise hotel at the center of Pattaya Beach on the Beach Road above Central Festival Pattaya shopping mall. Rooftop bar offers fine views over Pattaya Bay.

voyage.name: Royal Cliff Hotels Group
voyage.content: The 5-star property is on a 64-acre property on the beach behind Buddha Hill. The resort consists of four hotels each with its own ambience with Royal Wing being the most luxurious.

voyage.name: Underwater World
voyage.alt: อันเดอร์วอเตอร์ เวิลด์
voyage.content: This is an aquarium where there is a collection of marine species from the Gulf of Thailand. Visitors can walk through the acrylic pedestrian tunnel and witness various kinds of fish swimming all around. The tunnel is 105 m long divided into 4 zones. The first zone holds beautiful and rare fish such as angel fish, cleaning wrasse, and butterfly fish. The second zone displays soft-boned creatures such as sharks, sting

voyage.name: Colosseum Show Pattaya
voyage.content: This ladyboy cabaret show has operated since 2014.

voyage.name: Dongtan Beach
voyage.content: While this area is frequented by mostly straight families, it also boasts perhaps the largest concentration of LGBT community beach-goers in Southeast Asia as a 265 m section of this beach, from Tui's Place up to Rabbit Resort, represents Pattaya's only gay beach. The beach is divided into sections, each run by a separate vendor. You can relax and share your experiences with fellow gay travellers from around the worl

voyage.name: Hardbody Fitness Gym
voyage.price: 75 baht/day, 300 baht/week, 500 baht/fortnight, 750 baht/month, 2,000 baht/3 months, 3,500 baht/6 months, 6,000 baht/year
voyage.content: Small non-air-con free weights-oriented gym.

voyage.name: Jomtien Bowl
voyage.content: 8 lanes.

voyage.name: Jomtien Fishing Park
voyage.price: 100 baht/own rod, 200 baht to rent house rods
voyage.content: Guides are available, as is food (including your catch) and drink. Competitions on Saturday and Sunday 15:00-17:00 (100 baht/rod).

voyage.name: Jungle Bungy Jump
voyage.content: Beautiful tropical setting, 50 m (165 ft) over a jungle lagoon. Will pickup/return anywhere in Pattaya.

voyage.name: Pattaya Park and Tower
voyage.alt: สวนสนุกพัทยาปาร์ค
voyage.content: Large whirlpool with giant slides and a tower with a revolving restaurant. Visitors can also enjoy several games and rides on the tower and in its playground.

voyage.name: Bookazine
voyage.content: bookshop

voyage.name: Foodmart Supermarket
voyage.content: A 24/7 supermarket with a good selection of Western groceries and breads as well as import beers and wines.

voyage.name: Outlet Mall Pattaya
voyage.content: A large factory outlet mall selling authentic international brands like Adidas, Guess and Lacoste.

voyage.name: Pattaya Floating Market
voyage.content: It was built on dry land from scratch as a tourist attraction in 2008. It has four zones selling food and goods from each region of the country in wooden houses built in the regional styles. There are plenty of vendors paddling around in boats as well as sideshows ranging from zorbing to elephants to cultural and martial arts shows. Since the market is totally artificial it fills all the tourist expectations much bet

voyage.name: Rompho Market
voyage.content: The roofed wet market stocks meat, vegetables and fruit. Behind is a big shed selling clothing, bags and souvenirs. Later in the day the square in front hosts stalls selling street food.

voyage.name: Thepprasit Market
voyage.content: You can find the cheapest books in Pattaya at this night market.

voyage.name: Aquarius
voyage.content: Pleasant, inexpensive European dining.

voyage.name: Cafe des Amis
voyage.content: Charming, romantic continental dining.

voyage.name: Cafe Ritz
voyage.content: Nice British/continental food at reasonable prices. Very good daily specials.

voyage.name: Cheap Charlie's
voyage.address: 75/27 M.12 Soi Jomtien 5 Alley, Muang Pattaya, Bang Lamung District, Chon Buri 20150, Thailand
voyage.content: As the name implies a place for budget dining. However the food is exceptionally good value for money hence popular with expats. It can be crowded and service rushed at peak times. This is the second establishment with the same name following the same formula as the Pattaya venue in Soi Buakhao (but with different management). There is a loyalty card available for regular patrons with a modest joining fee.

voyage.name: Dar's Place
voyage.content: European and Thai food. Steaks, fresh coffee, espresso and cappuccino, outdoor and indoor dining. Daily 99 baht specials. Friendly English speaking Thai lady owner with European and Thai cook.

voyage.name: L'Olivier
voyage.content: Informal French food, reasonable prices.

voyage.name: Magg's
voyage.content: Inexpensive, good British/European food, daily specials. Breakfast, lunch, dinner. No air-con.

voyage.name: Mignon
voyage.content: Small, charming, inexpensive European food. Many beef dishes.

voyage.name: Mike's Mexican
voyage.content: Good fresh Tex-Mex in charming open-air setting.

voyage.name: Pagoda
voyage.content: Pleasant atmosphere, excellent service with continental/German cuisine at reasonable prices.

voyage.name: Poseidon
voyage.content: Sophisticated European dining at reasonable prices (drinks are a bit pricey). Terrific 144 baht buffet breakfast.

voyage.name: Hemingways Jomtien
voyage.address: 414/21 Thappraya Rd, Pattaya City, Bang Lamung District, Chon Buri 20150, Thailand
voyage.content: A Sports Bar & Restaurant that delivers quality meals in a comfortable air-conditioned establishment. Regular specials and events. Most sporting events are screened and there is a decent pool table at the rear of the bar.

voyage.name: Pan Pan
voyage.content: Long- established traditional Italian cuisine with wood-fired pizza oven. Very popular with Thai families.

voyage.name: Pupen Seafood
voyage.alt: ปูเป็น
voyage.content: Reasonably priced seafood popular with Thais. No air conditioning. During high season you can view the sun setting to the sea from small private tables set outside.

voyage.name: Sraan Resttaurant
voyage.content: Serves Thai and Western foods. Set in a garden which is ideal for a relaxing dinner or a small party. Recommended dishes include sautéed salted roasted duck, the shell in hell, chilled prawns, and goong lava (deep fried prawn with Thai herbal dressing and whipped cream on top).

voyage.name: Gian's
voyage.content: Sophisticated Italian cuisine.

voyage.name: News Steaks & Grill
voyage.address: 306/89 Chateau Dale Plaza, Moo 12 Thappraya Rd
voyage.content: Very good European/Swedish food in pleasant setting. Offers a single dish lunch special for 200 baht.

voyage.name: Sandbar By The Sea
voyage.content: One of the best views overlooking Jomtien/ Dongtan beach as it's away from the busy Beach Road environment. Food here is excellent, mostly in the high price range but with some items more budget friendly (especially Thai food). Also they have quality entertainment on most nights but it pays to book ahead. Good venue if you're celebrating an event.

voyage.name: Country Road III
voyage.content: The most visible member of the cluster of bars opposite Jomtien Plaza Condotel. Good place for inexpensive beer. It has 2 pool tables and charges a nominal fee per game.

voyage.name: Inn Lucky
voyage.content: Cozy bar with pool table, sports and lovely hostesses. Rooms with separate living area available for rent - 600 baht per night.

voyage.name: JB Pool House
voyage.address: 410/2-4-6 M. 12, Thappraya Rd, Jomtien, Chon Buri 20150, Thailand
voyage.content: Primarily a pool venue with 6 large quality tables and regular competitions. Drinks at reasonable prices. Tables can be booked on an hourly or per-game basis.

voyage.name: Rompho Bar Complex
voyage.content: This beer bar complex runs 250 m along Rompho Rd and has more than 50 open-air bars open from late afternoon till about 01:00 daily. It's highly competitive, with many bars offering live entertainment or free pool as enticements.

voyage.name: Soi 4 Bars
voyage.content: In the latter half of 2023, there was a lot of smaller bars in the adjacent Sois 2 & 3 close and move into Soi 4, Jomtien Beach. This has re-invigored competition in the Soi which had been primarily used for guest-house accommodation (and only a handful of bars). The Soi is unique as it's a divided roadway but carries very little through traffic. The atmosphere is more chilled for a quiet drink, chat and/or game of p

voyage.name: Soi 7 Bars
voyage.content: This will be Jomtien's second most popular bar locale behind Rompho Market (further to the north). Featuring several dozen bars (along with accommodation, massage and other businesses) along its 400m stretch between Jomtien Beach Road and Jomtien Second Road. Most of the bars are small but it's a narrow crowded environment making for a competitive vibe.

voyage.name: Soi Whitehouse
voyage.content: Much like Soi 4 it's only about half as long as the "through Sois", but it doesn't have the centre divide and carries some (limited) bus traffic to & from the Pooh Beach Resort/ Spa/ Hotel at the far end. Another concentration of bars making for a competitive environment. Bryghuset Bar on the right hand side as you enter the Soi is the largest single establishment being a consolidation of 3 bars previously here - plu

voyage.name: Tui's Place
voyage.alt: Tui's Place Guesthouse, Bar & Restaurant
voyage.price: 50 baht for coffee up to 350 baht for a carafe of wine
voyage.content: Full drinks menu. Serves a delicious array of local favourites and light snacks including salads, soups and sandwiches. Guest rooms range from 900 to 2,100 baht. Each room comes with a private bathroom, balcony, cable TV, free Wi-Fi, in-room safe.

voyage.name: Take Care Bar
voyage.address: 413/137 Thap Phraya Rd., Amphoe Bang Lamung, Chonburi
voyage.content: Jomtien now has several live entertainment bars in this area, but Take Care Bar was one of the early adopters & continues on. A resident band will play nightly from about 20:00. They focus on rock & roll covers and ballads from the 1960s/70s onwards. Requests are not just welcome but encouraged. Drinks are priced reasonably. No cover charge but a donation in the tip jar will be greatly appreciated.

voyage.name: Wombat & Kiwi Bar
voyage.address: 344 Jomtien Soi 9, Pattaya City, Bang Lamung District, Chang Wat Chon Buri 20150
voyage.content: Popular hangout for Aussie and Kiwi expats and visitors, and for others from around the globe. This business was established as a restaurant. Since then they've kept the food side of the business with regular specials, but have won several tourism awards for their overall standard of service & atmosphere. Sports are screened and live entertainment features on some nights.

voyage.name: Angel's Guest House
voyage.content: Angel is a baby-blue miniature boutique complex with Wi-Fi and Thai décor including shrines. Set back in a rustic part of the town, it's a 1-minute walk from the beach and a 15-minute songthaew ride to Pattaya. The staff speak English and can help with arranging local tours.

voyage.name: Jomtien Golden Inn
voyage.content: A small guesthouse offers convenient air-con rooms with cable TV and free Wi-Fi.

voyage.name: Jomtien Hostel
voyage.price: For 260 baht, a bed in the fan dorm room, privates for 2 from 550-1,050 baht with air-con
voyage.content: TV cable, shower, fridge, balcony for smokers, LGBT-run establishment. 20 rooms 8 apartments for monthly rent. Lift, wheelchair access.

voyage.name: Lek Hotel Jomtien
voyage.content: Offers clean, but very basic air-con rooms with breakfast.

voyage.name: Chang Charlie Inn
voyage.content: A boutique hotel a couple blocks from the main stretch of Jomtien Beach. Beautiful rooms with a mixture of traditional Thai as well as colonial British-Indian décor and art. Great rates for what you are getting (private patio, flat screen TV, free Wi-Fi, etc).

voyage.name: Jomtien Boathouse
voyage.content: This central 4-storey hotel faces across Jomtien Beach Rd to the sea. Rooms are a decent size with very pleasant décor and large beds. You have to climb the stairs for the best view, and bear in mind that the balcony rooms facing west do get hot in the afternoons. Wi-Fi signal is best in the lobby and bar.

voyage.name: D Varee Jomtien Beach
voyage.address: 457 Moo 12 Jomtien, Soi 13-14 Beach Road, Nongprue, Banglamung, Chonburi, 20150
voyage.content: 5-star hotel opposite Jomtien Beach featuring modern rooms with balconies overlooking the Bay of Siam. Offering 2 pools and a gym, it boasts a rooftop bar and 5 restaurants. 226 rooms.
